title: Parse task blocker metadata in JetBrains
description: Objective: expose the daemon's existing six blocker/attention fields to JetBrains without changing lifecycle or UI. Deliverable: backward-compatible Task fields and matching mappings in BOTH MoeJson.parseState -> parseTasks (snapshot) and MoeJson.parseTask (single-task update), pinned by JUnit fixtures. Own only moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt, moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJson.kt, and moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt. Add needsHumanReview Boolean default false; blockedReason, blockedResourceId, blockedFromStatus, blockedAt nullable String default null; blockedOnTaskIds nullable List<String> default null. Preserve valid string values, order and timestamps as sent; do not parse dates or infer flags from status, critique or reason text. For new fields only, error handling must reject wrong primitive kinds rather than coercing numbers/booleans into IDs or string true into human attention; filter malformed array members without rejecting the task. Keep unrelated permissive parser helpers/fields unchanged. Dependency on the time-cap model retirement is shared-file sequencing (Models/MoeJson/MoeJsonTest), not a new runtime dependency; recheck its landed evidence before modifying those paths. NOT in scope: daemon/schema persistence, UI badges, lifecycle/claim/unblock actions, serialization protocol redesign or other settings. Exact fresh verification from repository root on Windows PowerShell: & .\moe-jetbrains\gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test; exit $LASTEXITCODE . macOS/Linux equivalent: (cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test). Serialize shared Gradle runs; preserve foreign WIP. No implementation plan or approval is implied by this BACKLOG split.
definitionOfDone: Task has all six optional/defaulted fields, and existing call sites compile without supplying them; no daemon behavior or persisted data changes.

MoeJsonTest proves a populated BLOCKED fixture preserves needsHumanReview, blockedReason, blockedOnTaskIds, blockedResourceId, blockedFromStatus and blockedAt identically through both parseState snapshot and parseTask update paths; a Gson JSON round-trip retains all six.

JUnit covers omitted, explicit null and wrong-type new fields; false/null defaults are safe, mixed dependency arrays retain only string members, and malformed metadata never drops the otherwise valid task.

JUnit proves a later WORKING payload with cleared/omitted blocker fields does not retain prior block metadata; a REVIEW payload with needsHumanReview=true preserves attention independently of BLOCKED.
Regression fixtures exercise production parsers and fail on the prior field-dropping behavior; all pre-existing parser/time-cap retirement tests remain unchanged and passing.
Full moe-jetbrains Gradle test passes with fresh exit code 0 and nonzero test counts using the exact command in the description; completion reports all modified paths.
taskRails: Display-data contract only: do not change report_blocked, auto-unblock, nextStatusForRelease or daemon lifecycle rules.
Update both JetBrains Task parser paths; do not refactor unrelated parsing behavior or reintroduce retired task time-cap fields.
No shared build-output deletion, broad staging, or edits to foreign WIP.
